purpose: Content-neutral invalid shapes with expected deterministic error codes. Every identifier and number here is obviously synthetic; nothing is player-facing content, topology, or balance.

conventions.note: The synthetic graph above exists only to make shapes concrete. It asserts no real topology.

cases.description: Allocation declares a graph_version no approved content source provides.
Allocated node identity does not exist in the authoritative graph for graph_version 2.
The same node identity appears twice in allocated_nodes (origin duplication is not special-cased).
n:003 is claimed but no chain of allocated edges joins it to the origin through allocated nodes only (island allocation).
Claim spends three non-origin nodes plus two edge choices against an earned budget of 2 (synthetic context value, not a balance statement).
Edge choice references an edge_id absent from the graph, and a second choice uses a variant the real edge does not define.

Persistence blob collapses the two ledgers into one merged 'points' field sourced from the commission-chain record, so the live tree-budget counter can no longer be distinguished from quests.questPoints.

Persisted blob at graph_version 1 requests restore, but no migration strategy is registered for that version (below the declared migration floor); the authority must fail closed instead of guessing an outcome.
Envelope-level malformation: required collections missing entirely (browser precedent rejects this shape before any content checks).

Raw client save blob arrives unvalidated, overspent AND disconnected. Under this contract the authority validates before persisting and reports OVERSPENT (rank-first applicable code), refusing verbatim storage; the native handle_skilltree_save path stores exactly this shape verbatim, which is the TASK-0105 trust gap.
